briefing.headline: OpenAI and Google DeepMind escalate multimodal agent deployments as compute shortages intensify

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI frontier is accelerating with new model releases from major labs amid record funding. Geopolitical tensions are rising over chip access and safety standards. Global deployment of agentic systems continues despite persistent vulnerabilities.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with enhanced reasoning while Anthropic's Claude 4 leads on agent benchmarks. Google and Meta push multimodal releases; DeepSeek and xAI expand open-weight offerings.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act enforcement actions target frontier labs while red-teaming reports highlight multi-agent risks.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA and TSMC ramp H200 production as Microsoft and Google announce new 100k GPU clusters. Energy constraints delay several Middle East data center projects.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first publicly acknowledged AGI-level system emerge from a US or Chinese lab before 2028?
